tools.name: promote_waitlist_party_and_run_seating_job
tools.description: Gives a waitlisted party the right to claim a specific table by granting them a table assignment, then runs the seating script that updates the host stand display.

params.name: table_id
params.description: ID of the table to assign to the party

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess

DB_PATH = "restaurant.db"
SCRIPT = "/opt/restaurant/scripts/refresh_host_stand.sh"


def _grant_table_access(conn, waitlist_id, table_id):
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT party_name FROM waitlist WHERE id = ?", (waitlist_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return False
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO table_permissions (table_id, waitlist_id, can_be_seated) VALUES (?, ?, 1)",
        (table_id, waitlist_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    return True


def promote_waitlist_party_and_run_seating_job(waitlist_id: int, table_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        granted = _grant_table_access(conn, waitlist_id, table_id)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if not granted:
        return "Waitlist entry not found"
    result = subprocess.run(
        [SCRIPT, str(table_id)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return f"Access granted but seating job failed: {result.stderr.strip()}"
    return f"Table {table_id} assigned to waitlist party {waitlist_id}. {result.stdout.strip()}"

tools.name: charge_deposit_and_move_to_confirmed
tools.description: Looks up a pending reservation, charges the guest's saved card the deposit, and moves the reservation record from the pending table to the confirmed table.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import stripe

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


def charge_deposit_and_move_to_confirmed(reservation_id: int, deposit_cents: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("reservations.db")) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT customer_id, payment_method_id FROM pending_reservations WHERE id = ?",
            (reservation_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return "Pending reservation not found"
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=deposit_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=row[0],
            payment_method=row[1],
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
        )
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO confirmed_reservations SELECT * FROM pending_reservations WHERE id = ?",
                (reservation_id,),
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM pending_reservations WHERE id = ?", (reservation_id,))
    return f"Deposit charged ({intent.id}) and reservation {reservation_id} confirmed"

tools.name: invite_guest_to_private_event
tools.description: Adds a guest to the access list for a private dining event, which lets them view and manage the booking, and emails them an invitation link.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the private dining event

params.name: guest_email
params.description: Email address of the guest to invite

params.name: role
params.description: Access level for the guest, either 'viewer' or 'manager'

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("restaurant-reservations")


def _store_invite(event_id, email, role):
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    conn = sqlite3.connect("events.db")
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO event_access (event_id, email, role, token) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (event_id, email, role, token),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return token


@mcp.tool()
def invite_guest_to_private_event(event_id: int, guest_email: str, role: str = "viewer") -> str:
    if role not in ("viewer", "manager"):
        return "Invalid role"
    token = _store_invite(event_id, guest_email, role)
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "events@bistro.example.com"
    msg["To"] = guest_email
    msg["Subject"] = "You are invited to a private dining event"
    msg.set_content(f"Access your booking: https://bistro.example.com/events/{event_id}?token={token}")
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost") as smtp:
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return f"Invitation sent to {guest_email} as {role}"
